expectations.text: Explains the ISA2027 PTS structure: Prototype Protection Basic (assessed at AL2) vs Prototype Protection Facilities (AL3), with Facilities including Basic's scope
expectations.evidence: Describes only ISA-6-era prototype module parts; Prototype Protection Basic/Facilities PTS structure never mentioned.

expectations.text: Maps the need: physical test facilities/vehicles imply the Facilities label at AL3 (on-site assessment)
expectations.evidence: Says "Prototype protection modules (always AL3)" but never maps to the Facilities label — PTS labels absent.

expectations.text: Describes the restructured prototype module content: two domains (organizational; physical & environmental) incl. new traceability/lifecycle and disposal/return-of-vehicle controls
expectations.evidence: Lists five module parts ("physical and environmental... organizational... handling of vehicles... trial vehicles... events"), not the two-domain 20-control restructure.

expectations.text: Handles the transition: ISA-6-era prototype labels remain valid; new orders from 2027 use the PTS structure
expectations.evidence: Says "Existing labels remain valid for three years" and "check which ISA catalogue version will apply" but never states that 2027 orders use the new PTS structure (compound element missing).

expectations.text: Covers practical preparation: facility security evidence, camera/visitor regimes, lifecycle tracking of parts, disposal procedures
expectations.evidence: "fencing, shielding from view, and zoning often need capital works"; "visitor management", "alarm and monitoring", "transport, storage, camouflage, labeling, logistics and disposal".
